capabilities: Run a local credential-protected MCP server for AI agents
Recall scoped vault context as bounded context packs
Save governed, immutable memory records as Markdown
Review and approve proposed wiki and memory changes in batches
Report wikilink graph health with lint findings
extras: Desktop-only plugin with an extensive safety and credential model; full documentation is hosted externally and only linked from the README.
motivation: The author says personal knowledge bases fail in two opposite ways: conversations stay trapped in chat history, or automation writes too eagerly and pollutes the vault; Tracekeeper sits between those extremes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for AI agents to read vault context and persist memory, leaving conversations trapped in chat history or automation writing unchecked into notes.

relations.evidence: For shared use across Codex, Claude, OpenClaw, and other MCP clients

requires.name: An MCP client such as Claude, Codex, or OpenClaw

summary: Local MCP runtime that connects AI agents to the vault for scoped recall, governed memory saves, and review-gated wiki changes.
